Notice to End your Tenancy Because the Landlord Wants to Demolish the Rental Unit, Repair it or Convert it to Another Use
N13
To: (Tenant's name): Nguyen Thi Hoa
From: (Landlord's name): Danforth Lofts Inc. (fictional)
Address of the Rental Unit: Unit 2, 1330 Danforth Avenue, Toronto, Ontario
This is a legal notice that could lead to you being evicted from your home.
I am giving you this notice because I want to end your tenancy. I want you to move out of your rental unit by the following termination date: 31/01/2027.
Reason 2: I intend to do extensive repairs or renovations to the rental unit that require a building permit and vacant possession.
Important information: You have the right to move back into the rental unit when the repairs are complete if you give the landlord written notice before you move out.
Signature: Landlord  Signature Date: 20/09/2026
